tasks.name: Inquire Customer
tasks.outcome: Retrieve and display a customer record by customer number.

tasks.name: Add Customer
tasks.outcome: Create a new customer record with name, address, and contact details.

rules.plainEnglish: COMMAREA length must be at least WS-CA-HEADER-LEN + WS-CUSTOMER-LEN. If too small, CA-RETURN-CODE is set to 98 and the add is rejected.

tasks.name: Update Customer
tasks.outcome: Retrieve an existing customer record, allow edits, and save the updated data.

rules.plainEnglish: REQUEST-ID must be exactly '01UCUS' for an update. Any other value causes CA-RETURN-CODE=99.

tasks.name: Inquire Motor Policy
tasks.outcome: Retrieve and display a motor policy record.

tasks.name: Add Motor Policy
tasks.outcome: Create a new motor policy record for a customer.

tasks.name: Delete Motor Policy
tasks.outcome: Delete an existing motor policy record.

rules.plainEnglish: REQUEST-ID must be one of '01DEND','01DMOT','01DHOU','01DCOM'. Unrecognised values set CA-RETURN-CODE=99.

tasks.name: Update Motor Policy
tasks.outcome: Retrieve a motor policy, allow edits, and save the changes.

rules.plainEnglish: Update Motor COMMAREA length must be at least WS-CA-HEADER-LEN + WS-FULL-MOTOR-LEN. Shorter COMMAREA sets CA-RETURN-CODE=98.
